subject: Next steps & demo time proposals — Pioneer Health
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@pioneerhealth.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.pioneer@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & demo time proposals — Pioneer Health

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to hear about Pioneer Health's ingestion patterns and the latency targets your team is tracking. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we can lock the 30-minute intro/demo and include the right people: 

Recap (very short)
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for in-prod low-latency clinical summarization (sub-200ms p50 per-request target)
- Critical constraints: PHI handling with VPC/private deployment options, and audit log retention for 12+ months
- Stakeholders to include: ML infra, security/compliance, and a product owner

Proposed 30-minute session (we'll do a short demo + Q/A + next-steps discussion). Please pick whichever works best and tell me who you'll have on the call. Times shown in PT / ET: 
- Option A: Tue, Nov 3 — 09:00–09:30 PT / 12:00–12:30 ET
- Option B: Wed, Nov 4 — 14:00–14:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 ET
- Option C: Thu, Nov 5 — 08:00–08:30 PT / 11:00–11:30 ET

Suggested attendees from Redwood: Diego (AM/ownership), Mina Haddad (technical lead for infra + security prep).

Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf (short call notes) and mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx (starter MAP with success criteria / acceptance).

If none of the three fit, let me know a few windows that do and we'll work to match calendars. Once you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda and a brief list of items Mina will walk through on the technical deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez | diego.fernandez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0137
Redwood Inference

Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap and the options. We like Option C (Thu, Nov 5) most — 11:00 ET would work for our ML infra lead and product owner. If possible, can we aim for 11:00–11:30 ET on Nov 5? That slot is clean on our side.

A couple of asks before the call:
- Please include our security lead, Sarah Patel (cc'ed), on the invite — she'll want to hear about VPC/keys/audit logs.
- We'd like an infra engineer from your side for a few minutes of questions about deployment and KV cache behavior — will Mina be able to join for the technical bit?
- Can you confirm whether the demo session will be recorded and if you'll share the short MAP ahead of time?

Thanks — Alex

Alex / Sarah —

Great — Nov 5 at 11:00 ET is locked. I've added Mina (cc) who will run the infra/technical portion and can answer the KV/cache and quantization questions. Agenda below and I also attached an updated MAP with the agreed acceptance criteria.

Confirmed: Thu, Nov 5 — 11:00–11:30 ET (30 minutes)
Agenda (30m)
- 0–8m: Quick context from Pioneer (Alex, product owner) + success criteria
- 8–18m: Live Redwood demo focused on model routing, cache behavior, and latency profiles (Diego + Mina)
- 18–26m: Security/compliance Q&A (Sarah + Mina)
- 26–30m: Next steps & mutual action plan review

Recording: yes, we'll record the session and share the recording and slides within 24 hours.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=pioneer-demo-nov05
HubSpot opp: HS-54921

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx (updated, v1.1)

If you need Mina to prep a short runbook or sample sequence numbers ahead of time, tell us which subset of examples you want (e.g., 1) 1–2k token clinic summaries; 2) short triage snippets <512 tokens).

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
